professionalSummary.text: The candidate has been a project engineer and workstream manager on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
professionalSummary.witness: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.

experienceHighlights.witness: Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: The candidate supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.

skills.text: The candidate wrote the workstream boundary notes, the workstream risk registers and the hand-over notes for each stage gate, all filed under the project manager of record's gate submissions.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience as a workstream manager on retrofit projects, their involvement in planning and tracking workstreams under the stage-gate method, and their role in supporting plant shutdown windows and documenting stage gate activities. However, they do not establish that the candidate was the project manager of record on any project, signed any project charter or stage-gate submissions, or held a project budget under the programme's delegated limits.

evidence.text: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
evidence.notes: The candidate was a workstream manager, not the project manager of record.

evidence.text: Recruiter screen: candidate said he has been 'the senior PM in all but name' on the retrofits and that the projects 'were run by me day to day'; asked which charters or gate submissions he had signed, he said the project manager of record signed them 'because of the org chart'.
evidence.notes: The candidate claims to have been the senior PM in all but name, but no evidence is provided that they signed any charters or gate submissions.
